title: Novel Substituted Pyrazoles as SARM1 Inhibitors
abstract: Abstract                   This patent discloses a series of pyrazole derivatives as novel sterile alpha and TIR motif containing 1 (SARM1) inhibitors for the potential treatment of SARM1-related diseases, including neurodegenerative disorders. It provides details on the pyrazoles, their preparations, pharmaceutical compositions, and therapeutic applications.
